name: Norfolk
codexWorkflow: Open Norfolk AIR and search by property address.
Capture ownership, assessment, sales history, building information, parcel map, and report links.
Use Norfolk Property Search for real estate assessment and receivable account data when tax status is needed.
Save screenshots or copied values into the deal recon report with source and date.
fallback: If Norfolk AIR blocks automation or loads slowly, record the portal URL and search terms, then continue with manual evidence entry.
